picks.title: Nvidia-backed SiFive hits $3.65 billion valuation for open AI chips
picks.why_it_matters: A major late-stage round validates RISC-V as a viable alternative to ARM/x86 for AI workloads, signaling opportunity for startups building on open chip architectures or adjacent tooling.

picks.title: Cirrus Labs to join OpenAI
picks.why_it_matters: Acqui-hire signals OpenAI's aggressive talent consolidation, and the founding team's exit may free up experienced operators to start or advise new AI infrastructure ventures.

picks.title: France's government is ditching Windows for Linux, says US tech a strategic risk
picks.why_it_matters: European sovereign tech mandates are accelerating, creating tailwinds for startups offering open-source enterprise software, security, and cloud alternatives to US incumbents.
